title: The Chiquitos missions: Jesuit churches that are still in use
goal: Tell the story of the Jesuit missions of Chiquitos, using the ser passive for what was founded, expelled and restored.
grammar: the passive with ser + past participle

items: I can say what was founded, expelled and restored with *ser* + past participle.
I can say when the Chiquitos missions were declared World Heritage Sites.
I can name the main words for missions, churches and scores in Spanish.
